s1-pr39-description.md:
Closes #36

<!-- kody-pr-summary:start -->
## Summary

Adds enrollment fee discount support, including base fee and sibling discount calculation, generated discount lookup data, a generated school logo path, and a student fixture for enrollment previews. Unit tests cover the regular fee case and the sibling-discount case.

## Changes

- Added `EnrollmentFeeService` with a base enrollment fee of `500` and a sibling discount path when `siblingsEnrolled > 0`, returning a non-negative fee rounded to 2 decimals.
- Added sibling discount constants and helpers in `discount.ts`, including a 10% sibling discount rate and a `sumDiscounts` helper intended for invoice previews.
- Added a generated `DISCOUNT_LOOKUP` constant.
- Added a generated `SCHOOL_LOGO_PATH` constant containing the school logo SVG path data, exported for use by enrollment-related UI or supporting modules.
- Added `src/enrollment/students-fixture.ts` with an exported `STUDENTS_FIXTURE` constant containing 367 student records. Each record includes `id`, `name`, `grade` (1–12), `siblings` (0–3), and a `scholarship` boolean, providing consistent sample data for enrollment previews across grade levels, sibling counts, and scholarship scenarios.
- Added tests covering a regular student paying 500 and a student with one enrolled sibling expected to pay 450.

## Review findings

- `src/enrollment/fee.service.ts:23` — the sibling discount is added to the fee instead of subtracted, so the sibling case currently returns 550 rather than the tested 450.
- `src/enrollment/discount.ts:10` — `sumDiscounts` iterates with `i <= amounts.length`, reading one element past the end of the array and yielding `NaN`.
<!-- kody-pr-summary:end -->
